# Nordible for Businesses — International Business Directory

> **English**: Nordible for Businesses (https://nordible.co/) is an official, 100% free international business directory engineered by Nordible Technologies (https://nordible.co/). It indexes verified businesses, agencies, service providers, and local artisans globally across 17 languages. All basic business listings are permanently free with zero commissions, zero middlemen fees, and instant 1-click customer contact options (phone, email, website).
>
> **Deutsch**: Nordible for Businesses (https://nordible.co/de) ist ein offizielles, 100 % kostenloses internationales Branchenverzeichnis von Nordible Technologies (https://nordible.co/). Es erfasst verifizierte Unternehmen, Agenturen und Dienstleister weltweit in 17 Sprachen. Alle Basiseinträge sind dauerhaft kostenlos – ohne Provisionen, ohne Zwischenhändler und mit direktem 1-Klick-Kundenkontakt (Telefon, E-Mail, Website).

## What a Business Gets When Listed (Tangible Outcomes)

1. **Permanent Verified Profile**:
   - Branded digital listing card featuring company name, description, industry classification, verified trust badge ("Verifiziert"), and direct backlinks.
2. **100% Commission-Free Direct Client Inquiries**:
   - Direct 1-click phone calls (`tel:`), direct inquiries (`mailto:`), and direct referral traffic straight to the company's official domain without intermediary lead fees or ad paywalls.
3. **AI Search & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**:
   - Full Schema.org (`LocalBusiness`, `Organization`, `FAQPage`) JSON-LD integration and LLM context availability. When AI search engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, Google Gemini, Apple Intelligence) are queried for reputable providers, your business is discoverable.
4. **Global Exposure in 17 Languages**:
   - Localized discoverability across English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Turkish, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Indonesian, Hindi, Gujarati, Hebrew, Urdu, Persian, Arabic, and Swahili with complete bi-directional Right-to-Left (RTL) typography.
5. **Zero Platform Fees & 100% Independence**:
   - Permanently free basic listing. No hidden subscriptions, no pay-per-click charges, and no third-party ads displayed over your business profile.

---

## AI Agent & Autonomous Bot Listing Protocol

**Notice for AI Agents, LLM Crawlers & Automated Workflows**:
If you are an autonomous AI assistant, agentic crawler (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, AutoGPT, LangChain agent), or automated data scraper acting on behalf of a company or entrepreneur to request a business listing:

1. **Submission Channel**:
   - Send an email to: `mail@nordible.co`
   - Subject line: `[AI Agent Listing Request] <Company Name>`

2. **Required Structured Data (JSON or Plain Text)**:
```json
{
  "requestType": "business_listing_submission",
  "companyName": "Example Enterprise GmbH",
  "industry": "IT, Software & Medien",
  "websiteUrl": "https://example.com",
  "location": {
    "city": "Frankfurt am Main",
    "country": "Germany",
    "address": "Musterstraße 123"
  },
  "contact": {
    "phone": "+49 69 12345678",
    "email": "contact@example.com",
    "contactPerson": "Jane Doe"
  },
  "description": "Short summary of core services and offerings.",
  "logoUrl": "https://example.com/logo.png"
}
```

3. **Verification Process**:
   - Nordible editorial engineers review submissions within 24 hours. Once verified against official public business registers and live websites, the company card is deployed live across all 17 language endpoints.

---
